newsitem.title: USA: Verio unveils U.S. network of Internet providers.
newsitem.headline: Verio unveils U.S. network of Internet providers.

text.p: Verio Inc Wednesday said it unveiled a national network of internet service providers in an attempt to reach small and mid-size business and institutional internet users.
Verio said it has so far received $80 million in private financing to build its national backbone and to buy or invest in locally managed Internet providers as part of the network.

Verio said the group of locally managed Internet providers will benefit from having direct access to a high-capacity national backbone, peering relationships, a network operations center and engineering support.
Verio has already acquired or invested in 17 local Internet providers, the company said.
Verio was founded in 1996 as World-Net Access Inc by veterens of the Internet and telecommunicatins industries, the company said.
